item.title: August Critique Group: Howard Bossen
item.description:
Sunday, August 9, 2026 at 2 PM

Location: 1441 W Alabama St, Houston, TX 77006

HCP Members are invited to join our June Critique Group led by Howard Bossen, Professor Emeritus of Photography and Visual Communication, School of Journalism at Michigan State University. You may register for free as a Presenter and get feedback on your work from Castro and fellow HCP members, or as an Attendee and partake in the discussion.
